fieldLabels.modelContextLength: 仅覆盖主聊天模型检测到的上下文窗口（以 token 计）。保持为 0 则使用所选模型检测到的值。不影响辅助模型/MoA 模型。
fieldLabels.browser.autoLocalForPrivateUrls: 私有 URL 使用本地浏览器
fieldLabels.browser.useRealProfile: 使用我的真实浏览器配置

fieldDescriptions.model: 用于新对话，除非你在输入框中选择其他模型。
fieldDescriptions.modelContextLength: 保持为 0 则使用所选模型检测到的上下文窗口。
fieldDescriptions.fallbackProviders: 默认模型失败时尝试的备用 provider:model 条目。
fieldDescriptions.display.personality: 新会话的默认助手风格。
fieldDescriptions.display.showReasoning: 当后端提供推理内容时予以显示。
fieldDescriptions.desktop.repoScanEnabled: 扫描本地文件夹，并在“项目”中显示 Git 代码仓库。
fieldDescriptions.desktop.repoScanRoots: 要扫描的文件夹。留空时扫描主目录。
fieldDescriptions.desktop.repoScanExcludePaths: 发现代码仓库时跳过这些文件夹及其子目录。
fieldDescriptions.timezone: 当 Hermes 需要本地时间上下文时使用。留空则使用系统时区。
fieldDescriptions.agent.imageInputMode: 控制图片附件如何发送给模型。
fieldDescriptions.agent.maxTurns: Hermes 停止一次运行前工具调用轮次的上限。
fieldDescriptions.terminal.cwd: 工具与终端操作的默认项目目录。
fieldDescriptions.terminal.persistentShell: 当后端支持时，在命令之间保留 Shell 状态。
fieldDescriptions.terminal.envPassthrough: 传入工具执行的环境变量。
fieldDescriptions.terminal.dockerImage: 当执行后端为 Docker 时使用的容器镜像。
fieldDescriptions.terminal.singularityImage: 当执行后端为 Singularity 时使用的镜像。
fieldDescriptions.terminal.modalImage: 当执行后端为 Modal 时使用的镜像。
fieldDescriptions.terminal.daytonaImage: 当执行后端为 Daytona 时使用的镜像。
fieldDescriptions.codeExecution.mode: 代码执行被限定到当前项目的严格程度。
fieldDescriptions.fileReadMaxChars: Hermes 单次文件读取可读取的最大字符数。
fieldDescriptions.approvals.mode: Hermes 如何处理需要显式审批的命令。
fieldDescriptions.approvals.timeout: 审批提示在超时前等待的时长。
fieldDescriptions.security.redactSecrets: 尽可能从模型可见内容中隐藏检测到的密钥。
fieldDescriptions.checkpoints.enabled: 在文件编辑前创建可回滚的快照。
fieldDescriptions.memory.memoryEnabled: 保存有助于未来会话的持久记忆。
fieldDescriptions.memory.userProfileEnabled: 维护一份精简的用户偏好画像。
fieldDescriptions.context.engine: 在接近上下文上限时管理长对话的策略。
fieldDescriptions.compression.enabled: 当对话变大时对较早的上下文进行摘要。
fieldDescriptions.compression.codexGpt55Autoraise: 为受支持的 ChatGPT Codex OAuth 模型将压缩阈值提高到 85%。
fieldDescriptions.auxiliary.compression.timeout: 每次调用辅助压缩模型的等待秒数（默认 120）。本地模型较慢时请调高。
fieldDescriptions.browser.useRealProfile: 本地浏览使用你的真实登录状态。Hermes 会把你默认浏览器的配置（Cookie、登录、偏好）复制为受管快照，并用自带的 Chromium 驱动它——不会直接打开你的实时配置，且每次运行都会从实时配置刷新副本。还允许智能体在配置了云端浏览器后端时，按需打开本地真实配置会话。仅支持 Chromium 系浏览器（Chrome、Edge、Brave、Brave Origin、Chromium）；默认浏览器不是 Chromium 系时会给出明确报错。默认关闭。
fieldDescriptions.voice.voiceChatMode: chained：语音转文字 → Hermes → 文字转语音，使用下方的提供商。gpt-live：一个全双工的 OpenAI 语音模型（gpt-live-1）负责听和说，并把每个实际请求交给 Hermes——由你选择的任意模型带着完整工具集作答。需要 OpenAI API 密钥；语音层按每分钟 $0.05 计费。
fieldDescriptions.voice.gptLive.voice: GPT-Live 模式使用的音色，可填写自定义音色 ID。
fieldDescriptions.voice.gptLive.instructions: 附加到实时语音人设的句子（语气、语速、语言）。Hermes 保留自己的系统提示词。
fieldDescriptions.stt.enabled: 启用本地或提供方支持的语音转写。
fieldDescriptions.stt.echoTranscripts: 将语音消息的原始 🎙️ 转写文本发回聊天。
fieldDescriptions.stt.elevenlabs.languageCode: 可选的 ISO-639-3 语言代码。留空让 ElevenLabs 自动检测。
fieldDescriptions.tts.xai.voiceId: xAI 语音 ID（如 eve）或自定义语音 ID。
fieldDescriptions.tts.xai.language: 口语语言代码（如 en、pt-BR），或填 "auto" 自动检测。
fieldDescriptions.tts.xai.autoSpeechTags: 合成前让 LLM 在文稿中插入表现力音频标签（如 [laughing]、[sighs]）。
fieldDescriptions.tts.xai.optimizeStreamingLatency: 延迟与质量的权衡。0 = 最佳质量，2 = 最低延迟。
fieldDescriptions.tts.xai.sampleRate: 音频采样率（Hz）。越高音质越好、文件越大。
fieldDescriptions.tts.xai.bitRate: MP3 比特率（bps）。仅当编码为 mp3 时生效。
fieldDescriptions.updates.nonInteractiveLocalChanges: Hermes 从应用内更新时（无终端提示），保留本地源码修改（暂存）或丢弃（放弃）。通过终端更新时始终会询问。

fieldDescriptions.model: Used for new chats unless you pick a different model in the composer.
fieldDescriptions.modelContextLength: Overrides the detected context window of the MAIN chat model only (tokens). Leave at 0 to use the selected model's detected value. Does not affect auxiliary/MoA models.
fieldDescriptions.fallbackProviders: Backup provider:model entries to try if the default model fails.
fieldDescriptions.display.personality: Default assistant style for new sessions.
fieldDescriptions.display.showReasoning: Show reasoning sections when the backend provides them.
fieldDescriptions.desktop.repoScanEnabled: Scan local folders for Git repositories to show in Projects.
fieldDescriptions.desktop.repoScanRoots: Folders to scan. Leave empty to scan your home directory.
fieldDescriptions.desktop.repoScanExcludePaths: Folders and their descendants to skip during repository discovery.
fieldDescriptions.timezone: IANA timezone identifier. Blank uses the system timezone.
fieldDescriptions.browser.useRealProfile: Local browsing uses your real logins. Hermes copies your default browser's profile (cookies, logins, preferences) into a managed snapshot and drives it with its packaged Chromium — your live profile is never opened directly, and the copy is refreshed from it on each run. Also lets the agent open a local real-profile session on request even when a cloud browser backend is configured. Only Chromium browsers (Chrome, Edge, Brave, Brave Origin, Chromium) are supported; a non-Chromium default fails with a clear message. Off by default.
fieldDescriptions.agent.imageInputMode: Controls how image attachments are sent to the model.
fieldDescriptions.agent.maxTurns: Upper bound for tool-calling turns before Hermes stops a run.
fieldDescriptions.terminal.cwd: Default project folder for tool and terminal work.
fieldDescriptions.terminal.persistentShell: Keep shell state between commands when the backend supports it.
fieldDescriptions.terminal.envPassthrough: Environment variables to pass into tool execution.
fieldDescriptions.terminal.dockerImage: Container image used when the execution backend is Docker.
fieldDescriptions.terminal.singularityImage: Image used when the execution backend is Singularity.
fieldDescriptions.terminal.modalImage: Image used when the execution backend is Modal.
fieldDescriptions.terminal.daytonaImage: Image used when the execution backend is Daytona.
fieldDescriptions.codeExecution.mode: How strictly code execution is scoped to the current project.
fieldDescriptions.fileReadMaxChars: Maximum characters Hermes can read from one file request.
fieldDescriptions.approvals.mode: How Hermes handles commands that need explicit approval.
fieldDescriptions.approvals.timeout: How long approval prompts wait before timing out.
fieldDescriptions.security.redactSecrets: Hide detected secrets from model-visible content when possible.
fieldDescriptions.checkpoints.enabled: Create rollback snapshots before file edits.
fieldDescriptions.memory.memoryEnabled: Save durable memories that can help future sessions.
fieldDescriptions.memory.userProfileEnabled: Maintain a compact profile of user preferences.
fieldDescriptions.context.engine: Strategy for managing long conversations near the context limit.
fieldDescriptions.compression.enabled: Summarize older context when conversations get large.
fieldDescriptions.compression.codexGpt55Autoraise: Raise compression to 85% for supported ChatGPT Codex OAuth models.
fieldDescriptions.auxiliary.compression.timeout: Seconds to wait for the auxiliary compression model per call (default 120). Raise for slow local models.
fieldDescriptions.voice.voiceChatMode: chained: speech-to-text → Hermes → text-to-speech with the providers below. gpt-live: one full-duplex OpenAI voice model (gpt-live-1) listens and talks, and hands every real request to Hermes — any model you have selected answers with the full toolset. Needs an OpenAI API key; the voice layer bills $0.05 per minute.
fieldDescriptions.voice.gptLive.voice: Voice for GPT-Live mode. Custom voice IDs are accepted.
fieldDescriptions.voice.gptLive.instructions: Extra sentences for the live voice persona (tone, pace, language). Hermes keeps its own system prompt.
fieldDescriptions.tts.xai.voiceId: xAI voice ID (e.g. eve) or a custom voice ID.
fieldDescriptions.tts.xai.language: Spoken language code (e.g. en, pt-BR) or "auto" for auto-detection.
fieldDescriptions.tts.xai.autoSpeechTags: Let an LLM insert expressive audio tags ([laughing], [sighs]) into the script before synthesis.
fieldDescriptions.tts.xai.optimizeStreamingLatency: Latency vs. quality trade-off. 0 = best quality, 2 = lowest latency.
fieldDescriptions.tts.xai.sampleRate: Audio sample rate in Hz. Higher = better quality, larger files.
fieldDescriptions.tts.xai.bitRate: MP3 bitrate in bps. Only applies when codec is mp3.
fieldDescriptions.stt.enabled: Enable local or provider-backed speech transcription.
fieldDescriptions.stt.echoTranscripts: Post the raw 🎙️ transcript of voice messages back to the chat.
fieldDescriptions.stt.streaming: Show text while you speak (OpenAI, xAI, ElevenLabs). Falls back to the recording on any failure.
fieldDescriptions.stt.elevenlabs.languageCode: Optional ISO-639-3 language code. Blank lets ElevenLabs auto-detect.
fieldDescriptions.updates.nonInteractiveLocalChanges: When Hermes updates itself from the app (no terminal prompt), keep local source edits (stash) or throw them away (discard). Terminal updates always ask.
